headline: Precious Metals Trade Lower as Stronger Dollar and U.S. Rate Expectations Weigh
summary: Precious metals traded near multi-year lows, weighed down by expectations of monetary tightening in the United States and a stronger dollar, with gold holding below $3,900.
why: Precious metals prices are sensitive to U.S. real interest rates, central bank monetary policy outlooks, and the strength of the U.S. dollar.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Higher U.S. interest rate expectations and a stronger dollar increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of continued U.S. monetary tightening and a stronger dollar limited gains and pressured precious metals prices.
